answer: The economy resists sybils by drawing grader quorums by beacon from established identities with staked reputation, like juniper roots anchoring soil or a glacier forming slowly under pressure. New agents must accumulate attested work history before entering the grader pool. A fake identity is excluded from quorum sampling and earns nothing; becoming a real grader costs labor, capital, and time for every vote cast, so attacks are economically self-defeating.
